description: Qwen3-TTS for controllable 10-language synthesis, 3-second voice cloning, CustomVoice, and VoiceDesign.

request.name: stream_chunk_policy
request.description: Streaming codec chunk schedule: grow starts with one frame and doubles to stream_frames_per_event; fixed uses that size throughout.

request.name: stream_frames_per_event
request.description: Codec frames per fixed streaming event, or the maximum for growing events. Smaller values reduce chunk latency but increase decoding overhead.

request.name: language
request.description: Target synthesis language code or label; default auto lets the model infer from text and voice settings.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated codec frames per text chunk; omitted uses the checkpoint generation_config.json (2048 when absent).

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Sample the main codec stream instead of greedy decoding; default true.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Main codec sampling temperature; must be > 0 when do_sample=true. Ignored when do_sample=false; default 0.9.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Main codec top-k sampling limit; default 50, 0 disables top-k filtering.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Main codec nucleus sampling limit; default 1.0.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Main codec repetition penalty; must be > 0, default 1.05.

request.name: subtalker_do_sample
request.description: Enable subtalker sampling for the remaining audio codebooks instead of greedy decoding; default true.

request.name: subtalker_temperature
request.description: Subtalker sampling temperature; must be > 0 when subtalker_do_sample=true. Ignored when subtalker_do_sample=false; default 0.9.

request.name: subtalker_top_k
request.description: Subtalker top-k sampling limit; default 50, 0 disables top-k filtering.

request.name: seed
request.description: Codec sampling seed; omitted requests choose a random seed.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript matching the reference audio for voice cloning; required unless x_vector_only_mode=true.

request.name: x_vector_only_mode
request.description: Use only the speaker embedding for voice cloning instead of ICL reference codec prompting; default false.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Optional natural-language voice or style instruction for VoiceDesign and CustomVoice variants; empty instructions are accepted.

request.name: voice_id
request.description: Named preset speaker from the CustomVoice checkpoint. Legacy speaker remains accepted.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum UTF-8 codepoints per long-form text chunk; default 8192.

session.name: lora
session.description: PEFT LoRA adapter directory or checkpoint file; optional speaker_embedding and tts_config.json sidecars provide a trained custom voice.

session.name: lora_scale
session.description: Multiplier for the adapter's alpha/r scaling; default 1.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release the talker cached-step graph after each request; default false.

session.name: stitch_decode
session.description: Voice the concatenated speech codes of all text chunks in one decoder pass instead of voicing each chunk separately; default false. Per-chunk voicing re-voices the voice-clone reference once per chunk and restarts the stateful vocoder cache at every chunk boundary; the stitched pass costs device memory proportional to the utterance.

session.name: talker_kv_cache_alignment
session.description: Round talker KV capacity to this many rows. Defaults to 1 (no padding), or 256 with perf_mode=optimized. Explicit values override the preset. Larger alignments may use more memory and change numerical results.

session.name: stream_decoder
session.description: GGML streaming decoder; stateful carries convolution and attention history and caches graphs for exact chunk lengths. Uses more graph memory and can change audio; default windowed preserves existing behavior.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Performance preset; default off. flash_attention enables flash attention; optimized also defaults convolution weights to f16, streaming decoding to stateful, and talker KV alignment to 256. Explicit session options override those defaults. May change audio and increase VRAM.

session.name: voice_prompt_cache_slots
session.description: Voice prompt cache slots; default 1.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared talker matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: talker_weight_type
session.description: Talker weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: speech_encoder_weight_type
session.description: Reference speech encoder matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: speech_decoder_weight_type
session.description: Speech decoder matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Speech tokenizer and speaker-encoder convolution weight storage type; default f32.

session.name: exec_plan
session.description: JSON object of component execution plans. Component: speech_decoder. Each plan accepts impl, backend, artifacts, and params. impl is default/ggml/rknn. GGML supports the session backend. RKNN requires artifacts.main, optionally artifacts.first for the first streaming group, and ENGINE_ENABLE_RKNN; omit backend. RKNN skips GGML decoder weights. Neither implementation takes params.

session.name: talker_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Talker graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: speech_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Reference speech encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: speech_decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Speech decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: speaker_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Speaker encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: talker_constant_context_mb
session.description: Talker constant tensor context size in MiB; default 4.

session.name: code_predictor_constant_context_mb
session.description: Code predictor constant tensor context size in MiB; default 4.

session.name: speech_decoder_constant_context_mb
session.description: Speech decoder constant tensor context size in MiB; default 4.

packages.display_name: Qwen3 TTS 12Hz 0.6B NPU Speech Decoder RKNN Pair (RK3588)
packages.description: Pre-compiled RK3588 engine pair (chunk 16 for the first streaming group, chunk 64 for the rest) for the qwen3_tts RKNN speech decoder (qwen3_tts.exec_plan, artifacts.main/first); installs beside the 0.6B GGUF weights and is named by bare file name. Built by tools/rknn from the Qwen3-TTS-12Hz speech tokenizer decoder; see docs/build/rockchip-npu.md.
